lyrics:
[Intro: fiddle tune over strummed acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1: easy male tenor, storytelling]
Left Flagstaff at sunup with a thermos and a prayer
Mama's turning eighty and I swore that I'd be there
Got a card in the glovebox and a pie I didn't bake
And twelve hundred miles of interstate

[Chorus: group harmonies, banjo rolling, singalong]
So get me home by dark
Where the gravel meets the yard
Where the screen door slaps and the supper's on
And somebody's always playing cards
Roll on, wheels, roll on, heart
Get me home by dark

[Verse 2: tenor, band driving]
Gallup for coffee, Tucumcari for gas
A fella in Shamrock said, "Son, you're driving fast"
I said, "Sir, I've been gone since I was twenty-two
You'd be speeding, too"

[Chorus: group harmonies, banjo rolling, singalong]
So get me home by dark
Where the gravel meets the yard
Where the screen door slaps and the supper's on
And somebody's always playing cards
Roll on, wheels, roll on, heart
Get me home by dark

[Fiddle Solo: fast and joyful, band clapping]

[Verse 3: softer, guitar only at first]
Crossed the river at sundown, gold from side to side
Phoned to say I'm an hour out, and Mama nearly cried
She said, "Plate's in the oven and the kettle's on"
I said, "Don't blow the candles out. I won't be long."

[Final Chorus: a cappella first, then full band]
So get me home by dark
Where the gravel meets the yard
Where the screen door slaps and the supper's on
And somebody's always playing cards
Roll on, wheels, roll on, heart
Get me home by dark

[Outro: fiddle, a screen door slap, spoken]
There he is.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 148 BPM felt in two, 4/4, A major. A rolling, easy gallop that sways as much as it drives.

VOICE: Male tenor, relaxed and open, with a smile. A group of men and women sing every chorus in loose three-part harmony, like friends round a fire. The first half of the last chorus is voices and claps only. An old woman speaks the last line.

INSTRUMENTS: Fiddle playing the tune, rolling five-string banjo, strummed acoustic guitars, upright bass, brushes and a kick drum, mandolin chops, handclaps.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro fiddle. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:38 Chorus 1. 1:04 Verse 2. 1:26 Chorus 2. 1:52 Fiddle solo. 2:14 Verse 3, quieter. 2:42 Final chorus, a cappella then full band. 3:16 Outro, fiddle, a door, the spoken line at 3:34.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Warm and acoustic, close to a string band in a room, with modern clarity and a full low end.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The a cappella start of the last chorus at 2:42.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a young man thumbing a ride to a girl. This is a man in his fifties driving himself home to his mother while he still can.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Setting off, hurrying, the river at sunset, arriving.
